content.value_statement: Agricultural lease files can contain classification, pricing, and sale risks that require careful review. This guide structures preliminary checks, missing-document lists, and client questions under the Flemish Agricultural Lease Decree.
actual_capabilities: Guide preliminary classification of classical, career, and seasonal agricultural leases.
Identify potential reclassification risks in temporary occupation arrangements and cultivation contracts.
Structure rent-limit checks using coefficients supplied and verified by the user.
Flag preemption rights, termination questions, and potential effects on planned land sales.
Draft categorized attention points, action lists, client questions, and missing-document lists.
limitations: The folder contains a public guide only; original scripts, extension source, and templates are not included.
Current rent coefficients are not supplied and require independent verification.
The guidance covers the Flemish Agricultural Lease Decree, not other jurisdictions.
Outputs support professional review and do not constitute legal advice or guaranteed compliance.

use_cases.title: Prepare a notarial lease review
use_cases.description: Organize a draft lease into classification, rent, termination, and preemption questions before professional legal review.

use_cases.title: Complete an agricultural lease file
use_cases.description: Generate missing-document lists and client questions from the available contract and property information.

use_cases.title: Assess a proposed land sale
use_cases.description: Identify lease-related questions that could affect a planned sale, including preemption rights and termination constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a preliminary checklist for this Flemish agricultural lease: [contract text]. Group attention points by topic and identify missing information.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: organize an initial contract review.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare client questions
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these anonymized file details: [details]. List missing documents and draft client questions about land use, lease history, payments, and sale plans.

prompt_templates.title: Check proposed rent
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the proposed rent using these supplied inputs: [rent, cadastral information, region, coefficient, source date]. Show assumptions and calculations, and flag unverified inputs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: support a rent-limit review with verified coefficients.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze reclassification and sale risks
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this proposed cultivation or temporary occupation agreement: [text]. Consider actual land use and this planned sale: [details]. Identify reclassification, preemption, and termination questions. Separate known facts, assumptions, and issues requiring qualified legal review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: review interacting contract and transaction risks.

output_examples.input: Review a draft lease for three hectares near Kortrijk where the owner may sell to a nephew in five years.
output: Classification: Check whether mandatory agricultural lease rules apply to the actual use and proposed duration.
Sale: Assess tenant preemption rights and verify whether any exception applies to the proposed buyer.
Rent: Obtain the applicable current regional coefficient before checking the proposed amount.
Next actions: Confirm lease history, review the full draft, and obtain professional advice before agreeing to sale or termination terms.

output_examples.input: Prepare follow-up questions for a lease file containing only a draft agreement and the proposed rent.
output: Missing information: Parcel identification, actual land use, occupation history, and the applicable rent coefficient.
Documents to request: Existing agreements, relevant payment records, and any available property condition report.
Client questions: Who currently uses the land, under what arrangement, and are any sale or termination plans under consideration?
Review status: Classification and rent conclusions remain provisional until the missing facts are verified.

best_practices: Provide anonymized contract text, parcel information, actual land use, and relevant lease history.
Verify current legislation and rent coefficients using authoritative sources before relying on calculations.
Have a qualified professional review conclusions before signing, terminating, transferring, or selling.
anti_patterns: Treating the checklist as binding legal advice or a compliance guarantee.
Applying Flemish lease guidance to contracts governed by another jurisdiction.
Assuming the guide includes live coefficients, automatic legal updates, or the original package tools.

faq.question: What does this skill provide?
faq.answer: It guides preliminary lease reviews and produces attention points, action lists, missing-document lists, and client questions.

faq.question: Does it replace a notary or lawyer?
faq.answer: No. It supports professional review and does not provide authoritative legal advice.

faq.question: Are current rent coefficients included?
faq.answer: No. You must obtain and verify the applicable coefficients before relying on rent calculations.

faq.question: Can I use it outside Flanders?
faq.answer: It is intended for the Flemish Agricultural Lease Decree. Other jurisdictions require different legal guidance.

faq.question: Does this folder include scripts or templates?
faq.answer: No. It contains the public SKILL.md guide, not the original package scripts, extension source, or templates.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this guide?
faq.answer: The marketplace lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Document parsing and file support depend on the host tool.
